ask: Post our hiring news on the Acme company page on LinkedIn, not my profile.

steps.why: The plain LinkedIn row is the person's profile. Each LinkedIn company page is its own row, id linkedin_org_<id> with is_organization. Pick the Acme page row; if none is listed, the page isn't connected, so say so instead of guessing an id.

arguments.content: We're hiring two engineers in Lisbon. Small team, real ownership, a product people use every day.

steps.why: The page id alone posts as the page, not the profile. Saved as a draft with no requested_action; scheduling is a second call after the yes.

say: Saved to Acme as a LinkedIn draft for the Acme company page, not your profile. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: A guessed page id, or one that didn't come from list-accounts.
Scheduling in the same call that creates a page post.
Adding the personal account id when the user said not my profile.
A link the user didn't give.
